generatedCommentsNodes.comment: The test cases for ambiguous paths and list traversal are comprehensive but could be improved for clarity. The repeated setup of `XContentBuilder` and assertions can be refactored into helper methods to reduce redundancy and improve readability.

The method `getMapValue` is complex and could benefit from breaking down into smaller, more focused methods. Additionally, the handling of escaped dots in keys is not fully tested. Ensure that all edge cases for escaping are covered in tests.

The logic for inserting values into a map based on a path is correct but can be improved for clarity and maintainability. The method `insertValue` should handle cases where the path does not exist by creating the necessary nested maps or lists. However, the current implementation only modifies existing structures and throws an exception if ambiguity arises. Consider adding logic to create missing paths when possible.

review_comment:
We got a two-for-one with this bug fix 😁 

Since the semantic text field type adds sub-objects to the mapping upon first document ingestion, it cannot be in an object field with subobjects disabled. Before this fix, doing so resulted in Very Bad Things™, such as the [document parser handling inference sub-fields as runtime fields and triggering assertion failures](https://github.com/Mikep86/elasticsearch/blob/516aa119453d97ec7ac58292e8a91642a5d75893/server/src/main/java/org/elasticsearch/index/mapper/DocumentParser.java#L1039-L1039).
